{{Quote|Your Astromech Superstore|The shop's slogan|<ref name="Mission to Lianna">''[[Mission to Lianna]]''</ref>}}
'''Astromech Heaven''' was a large [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]]-orientated supermarket in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Lola Curich]]'s [[Lola Curich Starport|starport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. Open during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the shop sold most common astromech models at regular prices. Astromech Heaven also repaired most modern and common astromechs models, as well as servicing them in various ways. Services available included [[Limb/Legends|limb]] adjustments, [[Memory-wipe droid|memory wipes]], logic circuit checks, and refilling of any fluids, which all took from one to three [[Standard day/Legends|days]], as did repairs depending on the level of damage.<ref name="Mission to Lianna" />

==Behind the scenes==
Astromech Heaven was first described in ''[[Mission to Lianna]]'', a adventure written by [[Joanne E. Wyrick]] for [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and released in [[1992]]. It was included as a location players could potentially visit, although no actual events were described as taking place there.
